entities.summary: Norman Ray Harris was an American guitarist, producer, music arranger and songwriter, closely associated with Philly soul. He was a founding member of MFSB, the Philadelphia studio band, and one of the Baker-Harris-Young record production trio. Norman Harris was a composers & musicians from Danville (1947-10-14, Danville–1987-03-20). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
